questions.prompt: How do you switch the active Juju context to a model named 'staging'?
questions.explanation: 'juju switch <model>' changes the active context for subsequent commands.

questions.prompt: Which command configures model-level parameters such as update status intervals or logging?
questions.explanation: 'juju model-config' is used to view, set, and reset model configuration keys.

questions.prompt: When creating a new model with 'juju add-model <name>', what happens to your client's active context?
options: Juju automatically switches the active focus to the newly created model
It stays on the controller model and requires an explicit switch
The client disconnects from the controller
questions.answer: Juju automatically switches the active focus to the newly created model
questions.explanation: Adding a model immediately sets it as the current active model context for the client.
